hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'just +(check|test)[^|;]*\|[^|;]*(grep +-[[:alpha:]]*c|wc\b|grep[^|;]*\b(PASS|FAIL)\b)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run it once and read the output: the exit code already reports pass/fail, so counting the PASS lines or grepping for FAIL says nothing the exit status does not."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])python3' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run anything you point at this repository with just py, which puts the package on the path, or with uv run where no recipe fits; never the system python3 (see the Running and rewriting code section of CLAUDE.md)."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | grep -qE '[.]py$' && { out=$(just format 2>&1) || jq -nc --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("just format failed after this edit, so the file was not formatted:\n" + $out)}}'; } || true
